requirement: The system shall refuse entry to a member whose membership has expired or is suspended.
The system shall compute the monthly membership fee from the plan rate, any applicable discount and the configured tax for the member's region.
The member scans their card at the turnstile; the system verifies membership, records the visit and opens the turnstile.
The member books a place in a group class; the system checks capacity, records the booking and reserves a spot.
As a member, I want to view my upcoming class bookings so that I can plan my week.
As a gym manager, I want to suspend a member's account so that access is immediately blocked while an issue is investigated.
A member may only book a class if their membership plan includes group classes and they have not exceeded the weekly class limit.
Every entry, booking, cancellation and suspension event must be recorded with member, location, actor and time.
The membership table shall ensure that start and end dates are consistent, that the plan is recorded, and that status is one of the recognised values.
code:
-- gym membership table
CREATE TABLE membership (
    membership_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id      VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    plan_code      VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    start_date     DATE          NOT NULL,
    end_date       DATE          NOT NULL,
    status         VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    monthly_rate   NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    created_at     TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT membership_dates_order CHECK (end_date > start_date),
    CONSTRAINT membership_plan_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(plan_code)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT membership_status_chk  CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','EXPIRED','CANCELLED')),
    CONSTRAINT membership_rate_positive CHECK (monthly_rate > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX membership_member_idx ON membership (member_id, status);
CREATE INDEX membership_end_idx    ON membership (end_date);

-- class schedule table
CREATE TABLE class_schedule (
    class_id      VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    name          VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    category      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    capacity      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    starts_at     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    duration_min  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT class_capacity_positive CHECK (capacity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT class_duration_positive CHECK (duration_min > 0)
);
-- visit record table
CREATE TABLE visit (
    visit_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id     VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    entered_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    exited_at     TIMESTAMP,
    turnstile_id  VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT visit_exit_after_entry CHECK (exited_at IS NULL OR exited_at > entered_at)
);

requirement: Only a manager may suspend or cancel a membership; front-desk staff may only record visits and bookings.
The daily operations report shall list, for each facility, the number of visits, unique members, classes held and the total class attendance for the day.
